guide.title: How to use the console
guide.subtitle: Short answers to the things you do most. Button names are written as they appear on the page.
guide.seats.p: Each seat is one AI account with its own chats. Under the seat name are its usage bars: the 5-hour window and the week, how much is used and when each one resets. If the account holds a free limit reset, it is listed with a {use} button, which asks before it spends anything. {foldAll} shrinks every seat to the chats that are starred or need you.
guide.start.h: How do I start a chat?
guide.start.p: Press {new} next to a seat and type the task in the box at the bottom. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. Below the box you pick the working folder, the permission mode, the model and the {effort} slider. {auto} lets routine actions run on their own, {ask} shows an approval card before the AI edits files or runs commands, and {bypass} runs everything without asking.
guide.attach.h: How do I send a file, or stop a turn?
guide.attach.p: {attach} adds images or files. You can also paste an image straight into the message box. {stop} ends the turn that is running. The chat stays, and your next message picks it up again.
guide.approve.h: Something is waiting for me. What now?
guide.approve.p: A row marked {needsApproval} has a tool waiting: open the chat and press {allow} or {deny} on its card. A row marked {needsAnswer} ended with a question. Write your reply, or tap one of the suggested replies above the box (they only fill it in, nothing is sent). If no answer is needed, press ✕ on the row or {closeQuestion} in its ⋯ menu.
guide.keep.h: How do I keep a chat, or put one away?
guide.keep.p: Open the ⋯ menu on a row. {keep} adds a ★: the chat is never archived on its own and stays visible when its seat is folded. {archive} takes it out of the list. {showArchived} at the bottom of a seat brings archived chats back into view, and search finds them too. {move} lists a chat under a different project without changing its folder.
guide.auto.h: Why did a chat move to the archive by itself?
guide.auto.p: Two settings do this, both under {settings} › {tabUsage}. {archiveDone} (30 minutes by default) archives a chat that finished its work, needs nothing from you and has been quiet that long. {archiveDays} (3 days by default) archives a chat nobody touched in that time. Starred chats are never moved, and 0 turns either setting off. If you unarchive a chat, the finished-chat rule leaves it alone until you write in it again.
guide.search.h: How do I find an old chat?
guide.search.p: Type in the search box at the top of the sidebar. It searches every conversation, archived ones included, and stays at the top while the list scrolls. Press × in the box or Esc to clear it and get the normal list back.
guide.projects.h: What is the Projects page for?
guide.projects.p: {openProjects} in the sidebar opens it. Every folder with something going on gets one row: who is working, what waits on you, the last change, and each run as one line. {openProject} opens the folder's page. Quiet folders are under {allFolders}, where {newChat} starts a chat that works in that folder.
guide.runs.h: How do I run a bigger job across seats?
guide.runs.p: Under {startRun}, give the run a name, a folder and a brief, then press {plan}. The owner seat splits the brief into tasks and shows you the plan. {approve} starts each task on the seat fixed for its kind of work. A seat at its limit makes its tasks wait for the reset. They are never moved to another seat.
guide.project.h: What does a project page show?
guide.project.p: {needs} lists the chats waiting on you: an approval, an answer, a usage limit or an error. When nothing waits it says {allClear}. {working} shows the most recent active chat in large type, the others below it. {runs} draws each run as a bar of tasks, and {allTasks} opens the list. {happening} shows the top of the folder's HANDOFF.md and the latest commits. The chats come in two branches: {opened} lists the ones started in this folder, {related} the chats opened elsewhere that edited or read its files. {pin} files such a chat under this project, {notRelated} hides it here.
guide.ctx.h: How do I move between the chats of one project?
guide.ctx.p: A chat you open from a project page gets a project bar on top: {backTo}, {newChat}, {move} and the project's other live chats, one click each. A chat opened from the sidebar shows the normal view, without the bar.
guide.settings.p: {settings} sits at the top of the sidebar. {tabStart} › {lang} sets the language of the page and of the Telegram bot. {tabUsage} holds the two auto-archive settings. {tabProjects} › {freshAt} (40 % by default): when a run's task fills that much of its context window and stops unfinished, it carries on in a new short chat. Press {save} after a change.
composer.projectTitle: The project folder this new chat opens in. Click to pick one.
composer.pickHint: The new chat opens in this folder.
guide.folder.h: Which folder does a new chat open in?
guide.folder.p: The {chip} button next to the folder field shows it. Press it to pick a project, or leave it on automatic: the chat then opens in the one project your first message names (a path like seats/docs or the project's name), and in the projects folder when it names none or several. {newChat} always uses its project's folder.
tour.missing: There is nothing like this on the page right now, so here is what it does.
tour.ask.h: Would you like a quick tour?
tour.ask.p: It takes about two minutes and points at the real buttons, one at a time. You can start it again from Guide whenever you like.
tour.seat.p: One AI account with its own chats. Its name, email and role are here.
tour.usage.p: How much of the 5-hour window and of the week is used, and when each one resets.
tour.foldall.p: Shrinks every seat to the chats that are starred or need you. Press it again to open them all.
tour.new.p: Starts a new chat on this seat. Type the task in the box at the bottom.
tour.folder.p: The folder the new chat works in. Left on auto, your first message picks the project. Press it to choose one yourself.
tour.mode.p: Whether actions run by themselves, ask you first, or never ask.
tour.model.p: Which model answers. If you leave it alone, the seat's own default is used.
tour.effort.p: How hard the model thinks before it answers. Further right is slower and more thorough.
tour.attach.p: Adds images or files. You can also paste an image straight into the box.
tour.stop.p: Ends the turn that is running. The chat stays, and your next message picks it up again.
tour.needs.p: A chat marked like this needs an approval or an answer from you. Open it to reply.
tour.perm.p: The AI wants to run a tool. Allow it once, or deny it.
tour.reply.p: Write your reply here. A suggested reply above the box only fills it in. Nothing is sent until you send it.
tour.menu.p: Every chat has this menu: rename, keep, move to a project, archive or delete.
tour.keep.p: Adds a star. A starred chat is never archived by itself and stays visible when its seat is folded.
tour.archive.p: Takes the chat out of the list. The link at the bottom of the seat shows archived chats again, and search finds them.
tour.archiveDone.p: A chat that finished, needs nothing from you and stayed quiet this long is archived by itself. 0 turns it off.
tour.archiveDays.p: A chat nobody touched for this many days is archived. Starred chats never are.
tour.search.p: Searches every chat, archived ones too. × or Esc clears it and brings the list back.
tour.projOpen.p: Opens the Projects page: your project folders and the runs across seats.
tour.folders.p: Each project folder with its chats. From here you can start a chat that works in that folder.
tour.openProject.p: Opens the folder's own page: what waits on you, what is working, and the latest notes.
tour.runForm.p: Give a run a name, a folder and a brief. The owner seat splits it into tasks, and you approve the plan before anything starts.
tour.pjNeeds.p: Chats in this project that wait on you. When nothing waits, it says so.
tour.pjWorking.p: The chat working right now in large type, the others below it.
tour.pjRuns.p: Each run as a bar of tasks, one square per task. The full list opens below it.
tour.pjHappening.p: The top of the folder's HANDOFF.md and the latest commits.
tour.pbar.p: Shown when you open a chat from its project page: back to the project, a new chat there, and the project's other live chats.
tour.pbMove.p: Lists this chat under a different project. Its folder does not change.
tour.settings.p: Seats, Telegram, language, usage limits and more. Changes are kept only after you save.
tour.lang.p: The language of this page and of the Telegram bot.
tour.tabUsage.p: Usage meters, the limit warning and the two auto-archive settings.
tour.fresh.p: When a run's task fills this much of its context and stops unfinished, it carries on in a new short chat.
